name: Cinque
source:
"This is you, Cinque. What do you think? The others consider you too serious, logical, and cold. Honestly, wearing that robe doesn't help either, but I do not agree with them.

You just made it here, and you suffer from amnesia. It will take some time for them to learn all of your other fantastic qualities.

Oh, and it may take a while for you to remember them too, I suppose."

From [url=https://www.lotusreverie.com/]the official website.[/url]
